# results/

Central artifact store for all experiment outputs.

## Purpose

Every runnable module writes JSON, checkpoints, plots, and attack summaries here. The dashboard and report read from this folder. Pre-populated artifacts allow the dashboard to work **without a fresh training run**.

**Do not edit these files manually** — they are generated by scripts.

## Key subfolders

| Path | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `fl_rounds/run_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS/` | Per-run checkpoints and metrics |
| `fl_rounds/run_*/global_model_latest.pth` | Global model checkpoint |
| `fl_rounds/run_*/fl_metrics.json` | Per-round loss, accuracy, macro-F1 |
| `fl_rounds/run_*/fl_privacy.json` | Per-round ε per client |
| `fl_rounds/run_*/distribution_report.json` | Client class counts + KL divergence |
| `fl_rounds/run_*/model_meta.json` | Input dim, class names, model type |
| `attacks/` | Security attack JSON summaries |
| `benchmarks_baseline.json` | TEE overhead timings |
| `results.json` | Aggregated round history (dashboard `/results`) |
| `privacy_log.json` | Legacy privacy audit log |
| `epsilon_sweep.json` | Accuracy vs ε experiment |
| `epsilon_rounds.json` | ε consumed per FL round |
| `cross_validation.json` | K-fold CV results |
| `graphs/`, `plots/` | Generated figures |
| `pipeline_tests/`, `pipeline_runs/` | Output from `scripts/test_pipeline.ps1` |

## Root files (parent directory)

| File | Writer | Reader |
|------|--------|--------|
| `../status.json` | `fl/fl_server.py`, `fl/run_fl_simulation.py` | Dashboard `/status` |
| `../attestation.json` | `tee/attestation/` | Dashboard `/attestation` |
| `../model_meta.json` | Latest FL run | Dashboard `/model_info` |

## How it connects

**Writers:** `fl/`, `privacy/`, `evaluation/`, `security/`, `tee/benchmarks/`, `scripts/`

**Readers:** `dashboard/backend/`, `report/`

## Regenerating artifacts

```bash
python fl/run_fl_simulation.py --rounds 35 --clients 3 --strategy fedprox --dp
python security/attacks/model_inversion.py
python security/attacks/membership_inference.py
python security/attacks/gradient_poisoning.py --robust
python evaluation/cross_validation.py --folds 5
python evaluation/generate_graph6.py
```
